name: phase transformation
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 文中土体水分在冻融过程中发生的相态转变。
usage_note: 本文需考虑水分相变，但忽略了相对于路堤冻胀较小的无砟轨道热变形温度场。

complete_examples.text: The temperature field of permafrost is accompanied by freeze-thaw cycles of moisture during the long-term evolution, thus, the phase transformation of moisture in the soil must be considered.
